title: Adi-khanda, part 8 (portion 16)
html:
Pauganda-lila (continued): Vishvambhara tells His mother not to eat grains on Ekadashi and for a moment becomes motionless after saying "I am going"; the conversation of Damodara and Murari Gupta on how the Lord abides in the body of His devotee; the illness and departure of Jagannatha Mishra on the bank of the Ganga, the grief of Shachi and of the Lord, the funeral rites

Raga shri; disha: "O, what do we see! Glory, glory to Gauranga!" Refrain: "What nectar-bliss is the prema of my Gauranga! What a Gauranga is mine! Glory, glory!"

আর একদিন প্রভু বসি নিজঘরে ।
আপন-অন্তর-কথা পরকাশ করে ॥ ৬১৫ ॥

āra ekadina prabhu basi nijaghare |
āpana-antara-kathā parakāśa kare || 615 ||

ara ekadina — another day; prabhu — the Lord; basi nija-ghare — sitting in His house; apana-antara-katha — what was in His heart; parakasha kare — reveals

615Another day the Lord, sitting in His house,
revealed what was in His heart.

নিজ তেজ-অমিয়া পূরিত সব দেহ ।
নিরখি না পারি ঝলমল করে গেহ ॥ ৬১৬ ॥

nija teja-amiẏā pūrita saba deha |
nirakhi nā pāri jhalamala kare geha || 616 ||

nija teja-amiya — with the nectar of His own effulgence; purita saba deha — the whole body filled; nirakhi na pari — one cannot look; jhalamala kare geha — the house is ablaze

616His whole body was filled with the nectar of His own effulgence;
one could not look at it — the house was all ablaze with light.

মায়েরে দেখিয়া বৈল শুন মোর বোল ।
এক মহাদোষ মুঞি দেখিয়াছি তোর ॥ ৬১৭ ॥

māẏere dekhiẏā baila śuna mora bola |
eka mahādoṣa muñi dekhiẏāchi tora || 617 ||

mayere dekhiya — seeing His mother; baila — said; shuna mora bola — listen to My word; eka maha-dosha — one great fault; muni dekhiyachhi tora — I have noticed in you

617Seeing His mother, He said: "Listen to what I say:
I have noticed one great fault in you.

একাদশী তিথি অন্ন না খাইহ আর ।
যতনে পালিহ তুমি এ বোল আমার ॥ ৬১৮ ॥

ekādaśī tithi anna nā khāiha āra |
yatane pāliha tumi e bola āmāra || 618 ||

ekadashi tithi — on the lunar day of Ekadashi; anna — grain; na khaiha ara — do not eat any more; yatane paliha tumi — carefully keep; e bola amara — this word of Mine

618Do not eat grains any more on the day of Ekadashi;1
carefully keep this word of Mine."

মেঘ-গম্ভীর-নাদে কহিল মায়েরে ।
শুনি মাতা সবিস্মিতা সম্ভ্রম অন্তরে ॥ ৬১৯ ॥

megha-gambhīra-nāde kahila māẏere |
śuni mātā sabismitā sambhrama antare || 619 ||

megha-gambhira-nade — in a voice deep as thunder; kahila mayere — said to His mother; shuni mata — hearing, the mother; savismita — amazed; sambhrama antare — with awe in her heart

619In a voice deep as the rumbling of clouds He said this to His mother;
hearing it, the mother was amazed, and reverent awe filled her heart.

সঙ্কোচ-সম্ভ্রমে প্রেমে ভরিল শরীরে ।
পালিব তোমার আজ্ঞা বোলে ধীরে ধীরে ॥ ৬২০ ॥

saṅkoca-sambhrame preme bharila śarīre |
pāliba tomāra ājñā bole dhīre dhīre || 620 ||

sankocha-sambhrame preme — with shyness, awe and love; bharila sharire — the body filled; paliba tomara ajna — I shall keep Your command; bole dhire dhire — she says softly

620Her body filled with shyness, awe and love;
"I shall keep Your command," she said very softly.

শুনিঞা মায়ের বোল সন্তোষ-হৃদয় ।
ধর্ম শিখাইল সেই অন্তর-সদয় ॥ ৬২১ ॥

śuniñā māẏera bola santoṣa-hṛdaẏa |
dharma śikhāila sei antara-sadaẏa || 621 ||

shunina mayera bola — hearing His mother's words; santosha-hridaya — with gladdened heart; dharma shikhaila — taught dharma; sei antara-sadaya — He who is kind at heart

621Hearing His mother's words, He, kind at heart,
with a gladdened heart taught her dharma.

সেইকালে এক দ্বিজ আসি আচম্বিত ।
আনি দিল গুয়া-পান অতি শুদ্ধচিত ॥ ৬২২ ॥

seikāle eka dbija āsi ācambita |
āni dila guẏā-pāna ati śuddhacita || 622 ||

sei kale — at that time; eka dvija asi — a brahmana coming; achambita — suddenly; ani dila — brought; guya-pana — betel nut and leaf; ati shuddha-chita — with a pure heart

622At that time a brahmana suddenly came
and with a pure heart brought Him betel leaf and nut.

হাসিয়া তখনে প্রভু গুবাক খাইল ।
ক্ষণেক-অন্তরে পুনঃ মায়েরে ডাকিল ॥ ৬২৩ ॥

hāsiẏā takhane prabhu gubāka khāila |
kṣaṇeka-antare punaḥ māẏere ḍākila || 623 ||

hasiya — smiling; takhane — then; prabhu guvaka khaila — the Lord ate the betel nut; kshaneka-antare — after a moment; punah mayere dakila — again called His mother

623Smiling, the Lord then ate the betel nut,
and a moment later called His mother again.

মায়েরে কহিল প্রভু আমি যাই দেহ ।
যতনে পালিহ তুমি নিজসুত এহ ॥ ৬২৪ ॥

māẏere kahila prabhu āmi yāi deha |
yatane pāliha tumi nijasuta eha || 624 ||

mayere kahila prabhu — the Lord said to His mother; ami yai — I am going; deha — the body; yatane paliha tumi — guard it carefully; nija-suta eha — this is your own son

624The Lord said to His mother: "I am going; [this] body —
guard it carefully: it is your own son."2

ইহা বলি ক্ষণার্ধ নিশ্চেষ্ট হঞা রহি ।
দণ্ড-পরণাম করে লোটাইঞা মহী ॥ ৬২৫ ॥

ihā bali kṣaṇārdha niśceṣṭa hañā rahi |
daṇḍa-paraṇāma kare loṭāiñā mahī || 625 ||

iha bali — saying this; kshanardha — for half a moment; nishcheshta hina rahi — remaining motionless; danda-paranama kare — prostrates like a stick; lotaina mahi — stretched on the ground

625Saying this, He remained motionless for half a moment
and lay stretched on the ground like a stick.

নিঃশব্দে রহিলা পুন শচী তরাসিত ।
গঙ্গাজল মুখে দেই হৃদয় ত্বরিত ॥ ৬২৬ ॥

niḥśabde rahilā puna śacī tarāsita |
gaṅgājala mukhe dei hṛdaẏa tbarita || 626 ||

nihshabde rahila puna — again remained silent; shachi tarasita — Shachi, terrified; gangajala mukhe dei — pours Ganga water into His mouth; hridaya tvarita — hastily (with a racing heart)

626Again He lay silent; Shachi, terrified,
hastily pours Ganga water into His mouth.

ক্ষণেকে তখন প্রভু হইলা সম্বিত ।
সহজ-রূপের তেজে ঘর আলোকিত ॥ ৬২৭ ॥

kṣaṇeke takhana prabhu hailā sambita |
sahaja-rūpera teje ghara ālokita || 627 ||

kshaneke takhana — then in a moment; prabhu haila samvita — the Lord came to Himself; sahaja-rupera teje — by the effulgence of His natural form; ghara alokita — the house was lit up

627In a moment the Lord came to Himself,
and the house was lit up by the effulgence of His natural form.

মায়েরে কহিল প্রভু আমি যাই দেহ ।
এ কথা বিচার করিবারে আছে কেহ ॥ ৬২৮ ॥

māẏere kahila prabhu āmi yāi deha |
e kathā bicāra karibāre āche keha || 628 ||

mayere kahila prabhu — the Lord said to His mother; ami yai deha — "I am going; the body…"; e katha — this matter; vichara karibare — to judge; achhe keha — is there anyone

628The Lord said to His mother: "I am going; the body…" —
is there anyone who can judge this matter?

শ্রীমুরারি গুপ্ত বেজা প্রভুর অন্তরীণ ।
সর্বতত্ত্ববেত্তা সেই ভকতপ্রবীণ ॥ ৬২৯ ॥

śrīmurāri gupta bejā prabhura antarīṇa |
sarbatattbabettā sei bhakataprabīṇa || 629 ||

sri-murari gupta beja — Sri Murari Gupta the vaidya; prabhura antarina — intimate with the Lord; sarva-tattva-vetta — knower of all truths; sei bhakata-pravina — he, a seasoned devotee

629Sri Murari Gupta the vaidya, intimate with the Lord,
a knower of every truth, a seasoned devotee —

দামোদর পণ্ডিত পুছিল তার স্থানে ।
এ কথার তত্ত্ব মোরে কহ মহাজনে ॥ ৬৩০ ॥

dāmodara paṇḍita puchila tāra sthāne |
e kathāra tattba more kaha mahājane || 630 ||

damodara pandita — Damodara Pandita; puchhila tara sthane — asked him; e kathara tattva — the truth of this; more kaha — tell me; mahajane — O great soul

630Damodara Pandita asked him:
"Great soul, tell me the truth of this.

কিবা মায়া কৈল প্রভু কিবা কোন শক্তি ।
ইহার বিচার মোরে করি দেহ যুক্তি ॥ ৬৩১ ॥

kibā māẏā kaila prabhu kibā kona śakti |
ihāra bicāra more kari deha yukti || 631 ||

kiba maya kaila prabhu — did the Lord display maya (yogamaya); kiba kona shakti — or some power; ihara vichara kari — considering this; more deha yukti — give me a reasoned answer

631Did the Lord display [His] yogamaya,3 or some power?
Consider it and give me a reasoned answer."

মুরারি কহয়ে শুন শুন মহাশয় ।
আমি কি সকল জানি কৃষ্ণের আশয় ॥ ৬৩২ ॥

murāri kahaẏe śuna śuna mahāśaẏa |
āmi ki sakala jāni kṛṣṇera āśaẏa || 632 ||

murari kahaye — Murari says; shuna shuna mahashaya — listen, listen, good sir; ami ki sakala jani — do I know all; krishnera ashaya — Krishna's intentions

632Murari says: "Listen, listen, good sir:
do I know all the intentions of Krishna?

যে কিছু কহিয়ে নিজ বুদ্ধি-অনুমানে ।
যুক্তিসিদ্ধ হয় যদি রাখিহ পরাণে ॥ ৬৩৩ ॥

ye kichu kahiẏe nija buddhi-anumāne |
yuktisiddha haẏa yadi rākhiha parāṇe || 633 ||

ye kichhu kahiye — whatever I say; nija buddhi-anumane — by my own reasoning; yukti-siddha haya yadi — if it proves well founded; rakhiha parane — keep it in your heart

633I shall say something as my own reason suggests;
if it proves well founded, keep it in your heart.

শ্রবণ দর্শন ধ্যান আর সংকীর্তনে ।
হৃদয়ে প্রবেশে প্রভু নিজ ভক্তজনে ॥ ৬৩৪ ॥

śrabaṇa darśana dhyāna āra saṃkīrtane |
hṛdaẏe prabeśe prabhu nija bhaktajane || 634 ||

shravana darshana dhyana ara sankirtane — through hearing, seeing, meditation and sankirtana; hridaye praveshe prabhu — the Lord enters the heart; nija bhakta-jane — of His devotees

634When they hear [of Him], see, meditate and sing sankirtana,
the Lord enters the hearts of His devotees.

নিজ দেহ দেহ নহে নির্গুণ আকার ।
গুণে সে গুণের ভোগ আচার বিচার ॥ ৬৩৫ ॥

nija deha deha nahe nirguṇa ākāra |
guṇe se guṇera bhoga ācāra bicāra || 635 ||

nija deha — His own body; deha nahe — is not a [material] body; nirguna akara — a form beyond the gunas; gune se gunera bhoga — the enjoyment of the gunas belongs to the gunas; achara vichara — conduct and deliberation

635His own body is not a [material] body: it is a form beyond the gunas;4
the enjoyment of the gunas, conduct and deliberation [belong to those] in the gunas.

এতেকে ভকত-দেহ দেহ করি মানে ।
স্বচ্ছন্দ-বিহার তঁহি সব আচরণে ॥ ৬৩৬ ॥

eteke bhakata-deha deha kari māne |
sbacchanda-bihāra taṁhi saba ācaraṇe || 636 ||

eteke — therefore; bhakata-deha — the devotee's body; deha kari mane — regards as [His] body; svachchhanda-vihara — free play; tanhi — there; saba acharane — in all doings

636Therefore He accepts the devotee's body as [His] body
and there freely plays in all His doings.

নিজপূজা-অধিক ভকতপূজা মানে ।
পূজার সংগ্রহ তাথে জানে মনে মনে ॥ ৬৩৭ ॥

nijapūjā-adhika bhakatapūjā māne |
pūjāra saṃgraha tāthe jāne mane mane || 637 ||

nija-puja-adhika — above worship of Himself; bhakata-puja mane — He regards the worship of the devotee; pujara sangraha — the fullness of worship; tathe — in that; jane mane mane — He knows within Himself

637He regards the worship of His devotee as greater than worship of Himself;
within Himself He knows that in this lies the fullness of all worship.

আপনে ঠাকুর সেই তদধীন জন ।
লোক-আচরণে মায়া বলি দুই জন ॥ ৬৩৮ ॥

āpane ṭhākura sei tadadhīna jana |
loka-ācaraṇe māẏā bali dui jana || 638 ||

apane thakura — the Lord Himself; sei tad-adhina jana — is that one who depends on Him (or: "and that one depends on Him"); loka-acharane — in worldly usage; maya — by maya; bali dui jana — they are called "two"

638The Lord Himself is the very one who depends on Him;
only in worldly usage, by maya, are they spoken of as "two".5

আপনা অধিক কেনে মানয়ে ভকত ।
এ কথা বুঝিতে নারে সকল জগত ॥ ৬৩৯ ॥

āpanā adhika kene mānaẏe bhakata |
e kathā bujhite nāre sakala jagata || 639 ||

apana adhika — greater than Himself; kene manaye bhakata — why He regards the devotee; e katha — this; bujhite nare — cannot understand; sakala jagata — the whole world

639Why He regards the devotee as greater than Himself —
this the whole world cannot understand.

রসময় বিগ্রহ লাবণ্যময় দেহ ।
সকল সম্পদ তনু নিরমিল তেঁহ ॥ ৬৪০ ॥

rasamaẏa bigraha lābaṇyamaẏa deha |
sakala sampada tanu niramila teṁha || 640 ||

rasamaya vigraha — a form full of rasa; lavanyamaya deha — a body full of beauty; sakala sampada tanu — a body of every splendour; niramila tenha — He manifested (lit. "made")

640A form full of rasa, a body full of beauty,
a body endowed with every splendour — so He has manifested Himself.

বিলাস-বিনোদ-লীলা বিনে নাহি আর ।
নির্গুণ বলিয়া গালি দেই কোন্ ছার ॥ ৬৪১ ॥

bilāsa-binoda-līlā bine nāhi āra |
nirguṇa baliẏā gāli dei kon chāra || 641 ||

vilasa-vinoda-lila — play, sport and lila; bine nahi ara — apart from these there is nothing; nirguna baliya — calling Him "without qualities"; gali dei — reviles; kon chhara — what wretch

641He has nothing but play, sport and lila;
what wretch reviles Him by calling Him "without qualities"?

মায়ার কারণে আপে না হয় বেকত ।
ভক্তদেহে বিনোদ করয়ে অবিরত ॥ ৬৪২ ॥

māẏāra kāraṇe āpe nā haẏa bekata |
bhaktadehe binoda karaẏe abirata || 642 ||

mayara karane — by [His] maya (yogamaya); ape na haya bekata — He does not openly manifest Himself; bhakta-dehe — in the devotee's body; vinoda karaye — He plays; avirata — unceasingly

642By His maya He does not openly manifest Himself6
and plays unceasingly in the body of His devotee.

ভক্তের ভোজন নিদ্রা শয়ন বিলাস ।
তাহাতেই কৃষ্ণসুখ হয়ে ত প্রকাশ ॥ ৬৪৩ ॥

bhaktera bhojana nidrā śaẏana bilāsa |
tāhātei kṛṣṇasukha haẏe ta prakāśa || 643 ||

bhaktera — of the devotee; bhojana nidra shayana vilasa — eating, sleeping, resting, enjoyment; tahatei — in these very things; krishna-sukha — Krishna's happiness; haye ta prakasha — becomes manifest

643The devotee's eating, sleeping, resting and enjoyment —
in these very things Krishna's happiness becomes manifest.

ভক্তজন আর-জন আচরণ এক ।
দেহের স্বভাবে এক দেখে পরতেখ ॥ ৬৪৪ ॥

bhaktajana āra-jana ācaraṇa eka |
dehera sbabhābe eka dekhe paratekha || 644 ||

bhakta-jana ara-jana — devotees and other people; acharana eka — conduct is the same; dehera svabhave — by the nature of the body; eka dekhe — they look the same; paratekha — to the eye

644The conduct of devotees and of other people is the same;
by the nature of the body they look the same to the eye.

পরতেখ দেখি যার মানুষ-গেয়ানে ।
কোথা কৃষ্ণ মানুষ সে দেখিয়ে নয়ানে ॥ ৬৪৫ ॥

paratekha dekhi yāra mānuṣa-geẏāne |
kothā kṛṣṇa mānuṣa se dekhiẏe naẏāne || 645 ||

paratekha dekhi — seeing with the eyes; yara manusha-geyane — those who take [them] for men; kotha krishna — "where is Krishna?"; manusha se dekhiye nayane — "with my eyes I see a man"

645Those who, seeing with their eyes, take [them] for men
[say]: 'Where is Krishna? With my eyes I see a man.

কৃষ্ণ সর্বেশ্বরেশ্বর নির্গুণ ব্রহ্ম ।
মানুষ-শরীরে করে প্রাকৃতের কর্ম ॥ ৬৪৬ ॥

kṛṣṇa sarbeśbareśbara nirguṇa brahma |
mānuṣa-śarīre kare prākṛtera karma || 646 ||

krishna — Krishna; sarveshvareshvara — Lord of all lords; nirguna brahma — the Brahman beyond the gunas; manusha-sharire — in a human body; kare prakritera karma — does mundane deeds

646Krishna, the Lord of all lords, the Brahman beyond the gunas —
can He be doing mundane deeds in a human body?'

ইহা বলি নাহি মানে যে অধম জন ।
ভক্তদেহে প্রভুদেহ জানয়ে উত্তম ॥ ৬৪৭ ॥

ihā bali nāhi māne ye adhama jana |
bhaktadehe prabhudeha jānaẏe uttama || 647 ||

iha bali — saying this; nahi mane — does not accept; ye adhama jana — the low man; bhakta-dehe — in the devotee's body; prabhu-deha — the Lord's body; janaye uttama — the elevated one knows

647Saying this, the low man does not accept [it];
but the elevated one knows the Lord's body in the devotee's body.7

এই অনুমান-কথা মোর চিত্তে লয় ।
আপনে বুঝিয়া চিত্তে কর যে যুয়ায় ॥ ৬৪৮ ॥

ei anumāna-kathā mora citte laẏa |
āpane bujhiẏā citte kara ye yuẏāẏa || 648 ||

ei anumana-katha — this reasoning; mora chitte laya — is what I think; apane bujhiya — understanding yourself; chitte kara — decide in your heart; ye yuyaya — what is right

648Such is my reasoning, this is how I think;
understand for yourself and decide in your heart what is right.

সদা কৃষ্ণময় তনু বৈষ্ণব জানিয়ে ।
শ্রীবেদ-পুরাণ-ভাগবতেতে শুনিয়ে ॥ ৬৪৯ ॥

sadā kṛṣṇamaẏa tanu baiṣṇaba jāniẏe |
śrībeda-purāṇa-bhāgabatete śuniẏe || 649 ||

sada krishnamaya tanu — a body always full of Krishna; vaishnava — the Vaishnava's; janiye — know; sri-veda-purana-bhagavatete — in the Vedas, Puranas and Bhagavata; shuniye — we hear

649Know that a Vaishnava's body is always full of Krishna;
so we hear in the Vedas, the Puranas and the Bhagavata.

যার পদপাংশুতে পবিত্র সর্বজন ।
গঙ্গা-আদি করি তীর্থ সভার পাবন ॥ ৬৫০ ॥

yāra padapāṃśute pabitra sarbajana |
gaṅgā-ādi kari tīrtha sabhāra pābana || 650 ||

yara pada-pamshute — by the dust of whose feet; pavitra sarvajana — all people are purified; ganga-adi kari tirtha — the Ganga and other holy places; sabhara pavana — the purifier of all

650By the dust of his feet all people are purified;
he purifies even the Ganga and all the other holy places.

হেন জনার দেহে যে অধম করে বাদ ।
না বুঝিয়া সেই জন করে অপরাধ ॥ ৬৫১ ॥

hena janāra dehe ye adhama kare bāda |
nā bujhiẏā sei jana kare aparādha || 651 ||

hena janara dehe — about the body of such a person; ye adhama kare vada — the low man who disputes; na bujhiya — not understanding; sei jana kare aparadha — he commits an offence

651The low man who disputes about the body of such a person
commits an offence out of incomprehension."

এইমত দামোদর-মুরারি-গুপতে ।
নিবড়িল কথা দোঁহে হরষিত-চিতে ॥ ৬৫২ ॥

eimata dāmodara-murāri-gupate |
nibaṛila kathā doṁhe haraṣita-cite || 652 ||

eimata — thus; damodara-murari-gupate — Damodara and Murari Gupta; nibadila katha — concluded the talk; donhe — both; harashita-chite — with gladdened hearts

652Thus Damodara and Murari Gupta
concluded their talk, both with gladdened hearts.

আপনার দেহ প্রভু দেহ নাহি গণে ।
ভকত-জনার দেহ নিজ করি মানে ॥ ৬৫৩ ॥

āpanāra deha prabhu deha nāhi gaṇe |
bhakata-janāra deha nija kari māne || 653 ||

apanara deha — His own body; prabhu — the Lord; deha nahi gane — does not count as a body; bhakata-janara deha — the devotee's body; nija kari mane — regards as His own

653The Lord does not count His own body as a body,
but regards the body of His devotee as His own.

এতেক বিচারি গেল সেই দুইজনে ।
শুনি আনন্দিত কহে এ দাস লোচনে ॥ ৬৫৪ ॥

eteka bicāri gela sei duijane |
śuni ānandita kahe e dāsa locane || 654 ||

eteka vichari — having reasoned thus; gela sei dui-jane — the two departed; shuni — hearing; anandita kahe — joyfully tells; e dasa lochane — this Lochana Dasa

654Having reasoned thus, the two departed;
hearing of it, this Lochana Dasa speaks with joy.

Raga vibhasa; disha: "Ah, ah!" Refrain: "Ah, ah, my life!"

সর্বজন শুন আর অপরূপ কথা ।
যাহা শুনিলে ঘুচিবেক অন্তরের ব্যথা ॥ ৬৫৫ ॥

sarbajana śuna āra aparūpa kathā |
yāhā śunile ghucibeka antarera byathā || 655 ||

sarvajana shuna — listen, everyone; ara aparupa katha — another wondrous account; yaha shunile — hearing which; ghuchibeka — will be dispelled; antarera vyatha — the pain in the heart

655Listen, everyone, to another wondrous account;
when you hear it, the pain in your heart will be dispelled.

গুরুর আশ্রমে সব বেদতত্ত্ব জানি ।
ঘরেরে আইলা জগন্নাথ দ্বিজমণি ॥ ৬৫৬ ॥

gurura āśrame saba bedatattba jāni |
gharere āilā jagannātha dbijamaṇi || 656 ||

gurura ashrame — in the teacher's ashrama; saba veda-tattva jani — having learned the whole essence of the Vedas; gharere aila — came home; jagannatha dvija-mani — Jagannatha, the jewel of brahmanas

656Having learned the whole essence of the Vedas in his teacher's ashrama,
Jagannatha, the jewel of brahmanas, came home.8

দৈবনির্বন্ধে তার জ্বর আইল দেহে ।
বিপরীত জ্বর দেখি তরাস উঠয়ে ॥ ৬৫৭ ॥

daibanirbandhe tāra jbara āila dehe |
biparīta jbara dekhi tarāsa uṭhaẏe || 657 ||

daiva-nirbandhe — by providence; tara jvara aila dehe — a fever came upon his body; viparita jvara dekhi — seeing the grievous fever; tarasa uthaye — fear arises

657By the will of providence a fever seized his body;
seeing the grievous fever, all were struck with fear.

শচীর কান্দনা অতি ব্যাকুল দেখিয়া ।
প্রবোধ করেন প্রভু তত্ত্ব বুঝাইয়া ॥ ৬৫৮ ॥

śacīra kāndanā ati byākula dekhiẏā |
prabodha karena prabhu tattba bujhāiẏā || 658 ||

shachira kandana — Shachi's weeping; ati vyakula dekhiya — seeing her in great distress; prabodha karena prabhu — the Lord consoles; tattva bujhaiya — explaining the truth

658Seeing Shachi weeping in utter distress,
the Lord consoles her, explaining the truth:

মরণ সভার মাতা আছয়ে নিশ্চয় ।
ব্রহ্মা রুদ্র সমুদ্র পর্বত হিমালয় ॥ ৬৫৯ ॥

maraṇa sabhāra mātā āchaẏe niścaẏa |
brahmā rudra samudra parbata himālaẏa || 659 ||

marana sabhara — death for all; mata — mother; achhaye nishchaya — is certain; brahma rudra — Brahma, Rudra; samudra parvata himalaya — oceans, mountains, the Himalaya

659"Mother, death is certain for all:
for Brahma and Rudra, the oceans, the mountains and the Himalaya,9

ইন্দ্র বরুণ অগ্নি কালে সব নাশে ।
মরণ লাগিয়া কেনে পাইছ তরাসে ॥ ৬৬০ ॥

indra baruṇa agni kāle saba nāśe |
maraṇa lāgiẏā kene pāicha tarāse || 660 ||

indra varuna agni — Indra, Varuna, Agni; kale saba nashe — time destroys all; marana lagiya — on account of death; kene paichha tarase — why are you afraid

660Indra, Varuna, Agni — time destroys them all;
why are you so afraid of death?

তোর বন্ধুগণ যত আনহ এখন ।
সভে মিলি কৃষ্ণনাম করাহ স্মরণ ॥ ৬৬১ ॥

tora bandhugaṇa yata ānaha ekhana |
sabhe mili kṛṣṇanāma karāha smaraṇa || 661 ||

tora bandhugana yata — all your kinsfolk and friends; anaha ekhana — bring now; sabhe mili — all together; krishna-nama karaha smarana — let them help remember Krishna's name

661Call all your kinsfolk and friends now:
let them all together help [him] remember the name of Krishna."

বান্ধবের কার্য মৃত্যুকালে সত্য জানি ।
স্মরণ করায় প্রভু দেব যদুমণি ॥ ৬৬২ ॥

bāndhabera kārya mṛtyukāle satya jāni |
smaraṇa karāẏa prabhu deba yadumaṇi || 662 ||

bandhavera karya — the duty of kin; mrityu-kale — at the time of death; satya jani — knowing it to be true; smarana karaya — has [him] helped to remember; prabhu deva yadumani — the Lord, the divine Jewel of the Yadus

662Knowing that at the time of death this is truly the duty of kin,
the Lord, the divine Jewel of the Yadus, has [His father] helped to remember [Krishna].

শুনিঞা কুটুম্ব-বন্ধুজন সব আইলা ।
প্রভুর বাড়িতে আসি মিশ্রেরে বেড়িলা ॥ ৬৬৩ ॥

śuniñā kuṭumba-bandhujana saba āilā |
prabhura bāṛite āsi miśrere beṛilā || 663 ||

shunina — hearing; kutumba-bandhu-jana saba aila — all kinsfolk and friends came; prabhura badite asi — coming to the Lord's house; mishrere bedila — surrounded Mishra

663Hearing this, all the kinsfolk and friends came;
coming to the Lord's house, they surrounded Mishra.

পরিণত-বুদ্ধি যত বন্ধুগণ ছিলা ।
কাল প্রত্যাসন্ন দেখি যুকতি করিলা ॥ ৬৬৪ ॥

pariṇata-buddhi yata bandhugaṇa chilā |
kāla pratyāsanna dekhi yukati karilā || 664 ||

parinata-buddhi — mature in judgement; yata bandhugana chhila — all the friends there were; kala pratyasanna dekhi — seeing the hour near; yukati karila — took counsel

664Those friends who were mature in judgement,
seeing that the hour was near, took counsel.

বিশ্বম্ভর বোলে মা গো কি কর বিলম্ব ।
এইক্ষণে চাহি যত ইষ্ট-কুটুম্ব ॥ ৬৬৫ ॥

biśbambhara bole mā go ki kara bilamba |
eikṣaṇe cāhi yata iṣṭa-kuṭumba || 665 ||

vishvambhara bole — Vishvambhara says; ma go — mother; ki kara vilamba — why do you delay; ei-kshane chahi — at once are needed; yata ishta-kutumba — all near ones and kin

665Vishvambhara says: "Mother, why do you delay?
All our near ones and kin are needed at once."

ইহা বলি মায়ে-পোয়ে ধরি নিল তারে ।
বন্ধুর সহিত গেলা জাহ্নবীর তীরে ॥ ৬৬৬ ॥

ihā bali māẏe-poẏe dhari nila tāre |
bandhura sahita gelā jāhnabīra tīre || 666 ||

iha bali — saying this; maye-poye — mother and son; dhari nila tare — lifted him up; bandhura sahita — with the kinsfolk; gela jahnavira tire — went to the bank of the Jahnavi

666Saying this, mother and son lifted him up
and with their kinsfolk went to the bank of the Jahnavi.

বাপের চরণ ধরি কান্দে বিশ্বম্ভর ।
সম্বরিতে নারে অশ্রু গদগদ-স্বর ॥ ৬৬৭ ॥

bāpera caraṇa dhari kānde biśbambhara |
sambarite nāre aśru gadagada-sbara || 667 ||

bapera charana dhari — clasping His father's feet; kande vishvambhara — Vishvambhara weeps; samvarite nare ashru — cannot hold back tears; gadagada-svara — with faltering voice

667Clasping His father's feet, Vishvambhara weeps;
He cannot hold back His tears, His voice falters:

আমারে এড়িয়া বাপ কোথা যাহ তুমি ।
বাপ বলি আর ডাক নাহি দিব আমি ॥ ৬৬৮ ॥

āmāre eṛiẏā bāpa kothā yāha tumi |
bāpa bali āra ḍāka nāhi diba āmi || 668 ||

amare ediya — leaving Me; bapa — father; kotha yaha tumi — where are you going; bapa bali — "Father!"; ara daka nahi diba ami — I shall call no more

668"Leaving Me, father, where are you going?
Never again shall I call anyone 'Father!'

আজি হৈতে শূন্য হৈল এ ঘর আমার ।
আর না দেখিব বাপ চরণ তোমার ॥ ৬৬৯ ॥

āji haite śūnya haila e ghara āmāra |
āra nā dekhiba bāpa caraṇa tomāra || 669 ||

aji haite — from today; shunya haila — has become empty; e ghara amara — this house of Mine; ara na dekhiba — I shall see no more; bapa — father; charana tomara — your feet

669From today this house of Mine is empty;
never again shall I see your feet, father.

আজি দশদিক শূন্য আন্ধিয়ার ঘোরে ।
না পঢ়াবে যতন করি ধরি নিজ করে ॥ ৬৭০ ॥

āji daśadika śūnya āndhiẏāra ghore |
nā paṛhābe yatana kari dhari nija kare || 670 ||

aji dashadika shunya — today the ten directions are empty; andhiyara ghore — in pitch darkness; na padhabe — will not teach; yatana kari — lovingly; dhari nija kare — holding by the hand

670Today all ten directions are empty, all is pitch dark:
no one will teach Me so lovingly, holding Me by the hand."

এছন অমিঞা-বাণী শুনি জগন্নাথ ।
সকরুণ-কণ্ঠে নিঃসরে নাহি বাত ॥ ৬৭১ ॥

echana amiñā-bāṇī śuni jagannātha |
sakaruṇa-kaṇṭhe niḥsare nāhi bāta || 671 ||

echhana amina-vani — such nectarean words; shuni jagannatha — hearing, Jagannatha; sakaruna-kanthe — with grief in his throat; nihsare nahi bata — no word comes out

671Hearing such nectarean words,
Jagannatha in his anguish cannot utter a word.

গদগদ-স্বরে বোলে শুন বিশ্বম্ভর ।
কহিল না হয় মোর যে ছিল অন্তর ॥ ৬৭২ ॥

gadagada-sbare bole śuna biśbambhara |
kahila nā haẏa mora ye chila antara || 672 ||

gadagada-svare bole — says in a faltering voice; shuna vishvambhara — listen, Vishvambhara; kahila na haya — cannot be told; mora ye chhila antara — what was in my heart

672In a faltering voice he says: "Listen, Vishvambhara:
what was in my heart cannot be told.

রঘুনাথ-চরণে সঁপিনু মুঞি তোমা ।
তুমি পাছে কোন কালে পাসরিবে আমা ॥ ৬৭৩ ॥

raghunātha-caraṇe saṁpinu muñi tomā |
tumi pāche kona kāle pāsaribe āmā || 673 ||

raghunatha-charane — to the feet of Raghunatha; sampinu muni toma — I have entrusted You; tumi pachhe — lest You; kona kale — at any time; pasaribe ama — forget me

673I have entrusted You to the feet of Raghunatha;10
only may You never at any time forget me."

ইহা বলি হরি হরি করয়ে স্মরণ ।
গঙ্গাজলে নামাইল সকল ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৬৭৪ ॥

ihā bali hari hari karaẏe smaraṇa |
gaṅgājale nāmāila sakala brāhmaṇa || 674 ||

iha bali — saying this; hari hari karaye smarana — remembers: "Hari, Hari!"; gangajale namaila — lowered into the Ganga's water; sakala brahmana — all the brahmanas

674Saying this, he gives himself to remembrance: "Hari, Hari!"
All the brahmanas lowered him into the water of the Ganga.11

গলায় তুলিয়া দিল তুলসীর দাম ।
চতুর্দিগে বন্ধুগণে লয় হরিনাম ॥ ৬৭৫ ॥

galāẏa tuliẏā dila tulasīra dāma |
caturdige bandhugaṇe laẏa harināma || 675 ||

galaya tuliya dila — placed around the neck; tulasira dama — a garland of tulasi; chaturdige — on all sides; bandhugane laya harinama — kinsfolk and friends chant Hari's name

675They placed a garland of tulasi around his neck;
on all sides kinsfolk and friends chant the name of Hari.

চতুর্দিকে হয় হরিগুণ-সংকীর্তন ।
হেনকালে দ্বিজোত্তমের বৈকুণ্ঠে গমন ॥ ৬৭৬ ॥

caturdike haẏa hariguṇa-saṃkīrtana |
henakāle dbijottamera baikuṇṭhe gamana || 676 ||

chaturdike — on all sides; haya hariguna-sankirtana — there is sankirtana of Hari's qualities; hena-kale — at that moment; dvijottamera — of the best of brahmanas; vaikunthe gamana — going to Vaikuntha

676On all sides resounds the sankirtana of Hari's qualities;
and at that moment the best of brahmanas went to Vaikuntha.12

বৈকুণ্ঠে চলিলা দ্বিজ রথ-আরোহণে ।
ধরণী বিদার দেই শচীর ক্রন্দনে ॥ ৬৭৭ ॥

baikuṇṭhe calilā dbija ratha-ārohaṇe |
dharaṇī bidāra dei śacīra krandane || 677 ||

vaikunthe chalila — departed for Vaikuntha; dvija — the brahmana; ratha-arohane — mounting a chariot; dharani vidara dei — the earth is rent; shachira krandane — at Shachi's wailing

677Mounting a chariot, the brahmana departed for Vaikuntha;
at Shachi's wailing the earth is rent asunder.

পতির চরণ ধরি কান্দে লোটাইয়া ।
মো যাঙ আমারে লহ সংহতি করিয়া ॥ ৬৭৮ ॥

patira caraṇa dhari kānde loṭāiẏā |
mo yāṅa āmāre laha saṃhati kariẏā || 678 ||

patira charana dhari — clasping her husband's feet; kande lotaiya — weeps, rolling on the ground; mo yanga — I shall go; amare laha — take me; samhati kariya — with you

678Clasping her husband's feet, she weeps, rolling on the ground:
"I shall go! Take me with you!

এতকাল ধরি তোর সেবা কৈলুঁ মুঞি ।
বৈকুণ্ঠে চলিলা তুমি আমি রহিলাম ভুঞি ॥ ৬৭৯ ॥

etakāla dhari tora sebā kailuṁ muñi |
baikuṇṭhe calilā tumi āmi rahilāma bhuñi || 679 ||

eta-kala dhari — for so long; tora seva kailun muni — I served you; vaikunthe chalila tumi — you went to Vaikuntha; ami rahilama bhuni — I remained on the earth

679For so long I served you;
you have gone to Vaikuntha, and I am left on the earth.

শয়নে ভোজনে মুঞি সেবা কৈলুঁ তোর ।
আজি দশদিক শূন্য অন্ধকার ঘোর ॥ ৬৮০ ॥

śaẏane bhojane muñi sebā kailuṁ tora |
āji daśadika śūnya andhakāra ghora || 680 ||

shayane bhojane — at rest and at meals; muni seva kailun tora — I served you; aji dashadika shunya — today the ten directions are empty; andhakara ghora — pitch darkness

680I served you at your rest and at your meals;
today all ten directions are empty, all is pitch dark.

অনাথিনী হৈলুঁ তোর ছোট পুত্র লঞা ।
নিমাই থাকিবে কোথা কার মুখ চাঞা ॥ ৬৮১ ॥

anāthinī hailuṁ tora choṭa putra lañā |
nimāi thākibe kothā kāra mukha cāñā || 681 ||

anathini hailun — I am left forsaken; tora chhota putra lana — with your younger son; nimai thakibe kotha — where will Nimai live; kara mukha chana — looking to whose face

681I am left forsaken with your younger son;
where will Nimai live, to whose face will He look?

জগত-দুর্লভ তোর তনয় নিমাঞি ।
সব পাসরিয়া যাহ আমার গোসাঞি ॥ ৬৮২ ॥

jagata-durlabha tora tanaẏa nimāñi |
saba pāsariẏā yāha āmāra gosāñi || 682 ||

jagata-durlabha — rare in the world; tora tanaya nimani — your son Nimai; saba pasariya — forgetting everything; yaha — you go; amara gosani — my lord

682Your son Nimai, rare in all the world —
forgetting it all, you are going, my lord!"

মায়ের কান্দনা দেখি বাপের মরণ ।
কান্দয়ে শচীর সুত ঝরয়ে নয়ন ॥ ৬৮৩ ॥

māẏera kāndanā dekhi bāpera maraṇa |
kāndaẏe śacīra suta jharaẏe naẏana || 683 ||

mayera kandana dekhi — seeing His mother's weeping; bapera marana — His father's death; kandaye shachira suta — Shachi's son weeps; jharaye nayana — tears stream from His eyes

683Seeing His mother's weeping and His father's death,
Shachi's son weeps, tears streaming from His eyes.

গজমতি-হার যেন গাঁথিল সূতায় ।
নয়ানে গলয়ে জল বিশাল হিয়ায় ॥ ৬৮৪ ॥

gajamati-hāra yena gāṁthila sūtāẏa |
naẏāne galaẏe jala biśāla hiẏāẏa || 684 ||

gajamati-hara yena — like a pearl necklace; ganthila sutaya — strung on a thread; nayane galaye jala — tears flow from the eyes; vishala hiyaya — onto the broad chest

684Like a pearl necklace strung on a thread,
the tears flow from His eyes onto His broad chest.

ভক্তজন বন্ধুজন হাহাকার করে ।
প্রভুর কান্দনায় কান্দে সকল সংসারে ॥ ৬৮৫ ॥

bhaktajana bandhujana hāhākāra kare |
prabhura kāndanāẏa kānde sakala saṃsāre || 685 ||

bhakta-jana bandhu-jana — devotees and friends; hahakara kare — cry "alas!"; prabhura kandanaya — at the Lord's weeping; kande sakala samsare — the whole world weeps

685Devotees and friends cry out, "Alas, alas!";
at the Lord's weeping the whole world weeps.

শান্ত করাইল সভে মধুর-বচনে ।
সৃষ্টি নষ্ট হয় প্রভু তোমার ক্রন্দনে ॥ ৬৮৬ ॥

śānta karāila sabhe madhura-bacane |
sṛṣṭi naṣṭa haẏa prabhu tomāra krandane || 686 ||

shanta karaila sabhe — all soothed; madhura-bachane — with sweet words; srishti nashta haya — creation perishes; prabhu — O Lord; tomara krandane — by Your weeping

686All soothed [Him] with sweet words:
"Lord, at Your weeping creation perishes!"

নারীগণে প্রবোধ করিল শচীদেবী ।
বিশ্বম্ভর দেখি শচী সব পাসরিবি ॥ ৬৮৭ ॥

nārīgaṇe prabodha karila śacīdebī |
biśbambhara dekhi śacī saba pāsaribi || 687 ||

narigane prabodha karila — the women consoled; shachidevi — Shachi-devi; vishvambhara dekhi — looking at Vishvambhara; shachi — Shachi; saba pasaribi — you will forget everything

687The women consoled Shachi-devi:
"Looking at Vishvambhara, Shachi, you will forget everything."

আপনে সুধীর প্রভু সব সম্বরিয়া ।
কাল-যথোচিত কর্ম করিল সৎক্রিয়া ॥ ৬৮৮ ॥

āpane sudhīra prabhu saba sambariẏā |
kāla-yathocita karma karila satkriẏā || 688 ||

apane sudhira prabhu — the Lord, steadfast Himself; saba samvariya — restraining everything; kala-yathochita karma — the acts befitting the time; karila sat-kriya — performed the rites

688The Lord, steadfast Himself, restraining everything within,
performed the rites befitting the time.

তবে বেদবিধি-মতে যে ছিল উচিত ।
করিল বাপের কর্ম কুটুম্ব-বেষ্টিত ॥ ৬৮৯ ॥

tabe bedabidhi-mate ye chila ucita |
karila bāpera karma kuṭumba-beṣṭita || 689 ||

tabe — then; veda-vidhi-mate — according to Vedic injunction; ye chhila uchita — as was proper; karila bapera karma — performed his father's rites; kutumba-veshtita — surrounded by kinsfolk

689Then, surrounded by His kinsfolk, He performed His father's rites
as the Vedic injunctions prescribe.

পিতৃবৎসল প্রভু পিতৃযজ্ঞ কৈল ।
ক্রমে ক্রমে যথাবিধি ব্রাহ্মণ পূজিল ॥ ৬৯০ ॥

pitṛbatsala prabhu pitṛyajña kaila |
krame krame yathābidhi brāhmaṇa pūjila || 690 ||

pitri-vatsala prabhu — the Lord, loving His father; pitri-yajna kaila — performed the offering to the ancestors; krame krame — in due order; yathavidhi — according to rule; brahmana pujila — honoured the brahmanas

690The Lord, loving His father, performed the offering to the ancestors
and, in due order and according to rule, honoured the brahmanas.

তোয়াধার অন্ন ভোজনাদি দ্রব্য যত ।
ব্রাহ্মণেরে দিলা প্রভু পিতৃভকত ॥ ৬৯১ ॥

toẏādhāra anna bhojanādi drabya yata |
brāhmaṇere dilā prabhu pitṛbhakata || 691 ||

toyadhara — water vessels; anna — rice; bhojana-adi dravya yata — food and all other gifts; brahmanere dila prabhu — the Lord gave to the brahmanas; pitri-bhakata — devoted to His father

691Water vessels, rice, food and all other gifts
the Lord, devoted to His father, gave to the brahmanas.

জগন্নাথ-বৈকুণ্ঠগমন এই কথা ।
আপনে সে দ্বিজোত্তম বিশ্বম্ভর-পিতা ॥ ৬৯২ ॥

jagannātha-baikuṇṭhagamana ei kathā |
āpane se dbijottama biśbambhara-pitā || 692 ||

jagannatha-vaikuntha-gamana — Jagannatha's going to Vaikuntha; ei katha — this is the account; apane — Himself; se dvijottama — that best of brahmanas; vishvambhara-pita — the father of Vishvambhara

692This is the account of Jagannatha's going to Vaikuntha —
of that best of brahmanas who was the father of Vishvambhara Himself.

শ্রদ্ধাবন্ত জন যদি এই কথা শুনে ।
বৈকুণ্ঠে চলয়ে সেই গঙ্গায় মরণে ॥ ৬৯৩ ॥

śraddhābanta jana yadi ei kathā śune |
baikuṇṭhe calaẏe sei gaṅgāẏa maraṇe || 693 ||

shraddhavanta jana — a person with faith; yadi ei katha shune — if he hears this account; vaikunthe chalaye sei — he goes to Vaikuntha; gangaya marane — [as] by death at the Ganga

693If a person hears this account with faith,
he goes to Vaikuntha, as one who dies at the Ganga.

গোরাচাঁদ দেখি শচী ছাড়য়ে নিশ্বাস ।
পিতৃশূন্য পুত্র পাছে পায়েন তরাস ॥ ৬৯৪ ॥

gorācāṁda dekhi śacī chāṛaẏe niśbāsa |
pitṛśūnya putra pāche pāẏena tarāsa || 694 ||

gorachanda dekhi — looking at Gorachand; shachi chhadaye nishvasa — Shachi sighs; pitri-shunya putra — the fatherless son; pachhe payena tarasa — lest He fall into despair

694Looking at Gorachand, Shachi sighs:
"May the fatherless son not fall into despair!

বিদ্যারসে চিত্ত যদি ডুবয়ে ইহার ।
তবে মনঃসুখে পুত্র গোঙায় আমার ॥ ৬৯৫ ॥

bidyārase citta yadi ḍubaẏe ihāra |
tabe manaḥsukhe putra goṅāẏa āmāra || 695 ||

vidya-rase — in the taste of learning; chitta yadi dubaye ihara — if His heart is immersed; tabe — then; manah-sukhe — happily; putra gongaya amara — my son will pass His days

695If His heart becomes immersed in the taste of learning,
then my son will pass His days happily."

হেন অদ্ভুত কথা শুন সর্বজন ।
চৈতন্যচরিত্র কিছু কহয়ে লোচন ॥ ৬৯৬ ॥

hena adbhuta kathā śuna sarbajana |
caitanyacaritra kichu kahaẏe locana || 696 ||

hena adbhuta katha — this wondrous account; shuna sarvajana — listen, everyone; chaitanya-charitra kichhu — something of Chaitanya's deeds; kahaye lochana — Lochana tells

696Listen, everyone, to this wondrous account:
Lochana tells something of the deeds of Chaitanya.

✦

Notes

  1. Ekadashi is the eleventh day of each lunar fortnight, a day of fasting; "anna" means grain (rice and the like). Bhaktisiddhanta's summary (en/14) stresses that by forbidding His mother to eat grain on Ekadashi the Lord taught the whole world. In Murari — 1.07.18–20.
  2. In Murari (1.07.21) the Lord says: "I am going. Guard the body of your son, which will for half a moment become motionless." The conversation of Damodara and Murari (vv. 629–653) interprets exactly these words.
  3. Literally "maya". In Murari (1.07.24, 27) the same question concerns the Lord's "yogamaya": when said of the Lord, maya is His internal power, yogamaya.
  4. "Nirguna" here means beyond the material gunas, not "devoid of form and qualities": in vv. 640–641 Lochana Dasa expressly condemns those who call the Lord "nirguna" in an impersonal sense. In v. 640 "niramila" literally means "made": the Lord Himself manifests His eternal form.
  5. The line also admits the reading: "He Himself is the Lord, and that one (the devotee) depends on Him." From the sense of the whole argument (vv. 624, 653), Lochana Dasa is explaining the words "I am going; the body is your son": in Gaura the Lord Himself plays the part of His own devotee, and that people see "two" here is the working of His maya (yogamaya). The eternal distinction between the Lord and the devotee (vv. 637, 639) is not denied by this.
  6. Here maya is the power by which the Lord conceals Himself, that is, yogamaya.
  7. The reasoning of vv. 634–653 follows Murari (1.08.1–7): the Lord enters the heart of the devotee and regards the devotee's body as His own. In the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding (Bhaktisiddhanta), the Lord's body is not different from Himself and is not material, and Mahaprabhu is Krishna Himself who has assumed the form and feeling of His own devotee (bhakta-rupa); what is said of the "devotee's body" therefore does not mean that in Gaura the Lord uses a separate, human body.
  8. The subject of the line is Jagannatha Mishra; cf. Murari (1.08.13): the Lord's father too studied Vedanta and other scriptures.
  9. According to the Puranas, Brahma and Rudra, who govern the universe, are also not eternal in these offices: at the end of Brahma's life the universe is dissolved.
  10. Raghunatha ("Lord of the Raghu dynasty") is Sri Ramachandra; Jagannatha says the same words in Murari (1.08.17).
  11. The custom of antarjali: the dying person is carried to the bank of the Ganga and immersed waist-deep in its water so that he may leave the body remembering Hari.
  12. Jagannatha Mishra is an eternal associate of the Lord (in the Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika — Nanda Maharaja and Vasudeva); his departure is not an ordinary death, and Lochana Dasa speaks of it as leaving for Vaikuntha on a chariot.
